svg.title: First-move accuracy by puzzle rating
svg.desc: Share of the 240 test puzzles where the first move was right, in 200-point rating bands, with 95% intervals. Bare model: 46 of 240 overall, fairly flat across bands. Final configuration r1a: 123 of 240, falling only slowly as puzzles get harder. A dashed curve shows what a human solver rated about 1510 would be expected to score, falling steeply with rating. Elo-style rating fits: bare about 1163 (95% CI 1079 to 1237), final about 1511 (95% CI 1443 to 1577).
